chiru: Khan ama na synagogue ah rulutret a makhan khutchar miring khat ruawm
english: And He entered the synagogue again, and a man was there who had a withered hand

chiru: Khan amani na ama jar pekna rang, Sabbath nikho khan madam maw, tia ruva uh
english: So they watched Him closely, whether He would heal him on the Sabbath

chiru: Inia khutcharpa dieng ruti, Akar hin vak ding roh
english: And He said to the man who had the withered hand, Step forward

chiru: Khan amani dieng ruti, Sabbath nikho hin atha thaw, ninawkle ashie thaw
english: Then He said to them, Is it lawful on the Sabbath to do good or to do evil

chiru: Makhan mulung hang le roroia, amani kha enroko ruthaw phakhan
english: And when He had looked around at them with anger, He said Stretch out your hand

chiru: Khan Pharisee hai na nawtshun a rushok ua ama kha itia maw that rang
english: Then the Pharisees went out and immediately plotted against Him

chiru: Inia Jesu na akhaichawi hai le roroia thampui tieng rukir joi
english: But Jesus withdrew with His disciples to the sea

chiru: Tun Jesu na lawn ah ruhawng a ama na idit miring hai kha rukoi
english: And He went up on the mountain and called to Him those He wanted

chiru: Khashole ama le rawtawp rang le chawngshem tir rang
english: Then He appointed twelve, that they might be with Him

chiru: Tunitaawm Pathien mulungmining athaw ama kha kunu, kanaipangnu, khan kanaipangpa kha inih
english: For whoever does the will of God is My brother and My sister and mother
